card.name: End of section cross-references
card.fires_on: The closing bracket or number of a bracketed section cross-reference such as [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)], just before a period. Also fires on the first item of a list, like a month, or on a web address start.

modes.label: Cross-reference close
modes.description: Closing ] or ) of a [see ... (5.x)] pointer to another label section.
modes.example: [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)<< ]>> . To reduce the risk of hypersensitivity

modes.label: List item before comma
modes.description: A list item or link start where a comma or line break is expected next.
modes.example: Bloom Time:<< Jun>> , Jul , Aug , Sep B

card.writes: It promotes spaced commas, periods and line breaks, so punctuation is expected next.
card.plain: It marks the end of a bracketed 'see section' pointer, where a period or comma comes next.
